messages:
Ava (Finance): Thanks everyone for joining the finance segment in today's all-hands. Starting this thread to capture follow-ups on spend safeguards, runway assumptions, and procurement timelines — drop questions and I'll respond.
Priya (Product): Quick Q — what's the current runway assumption and are we still modeling hiring for Q3? :eyes:
Ava (Finance): Current burn ~ $3.2M/month (operational + infra). With our committed revenue and current hiring plan runway ~14 months. If we resume full hiring in Q3 runway drops ~to 10 months.
Jonas (Eng): Is the Dedicated capacity contract impact included in that? We've been evaluating a 6-month reserved pool for critical models.
Ava (Finance): Yes the model for 14 months includes the planned Dedicated commitments for core infra. Note: committed reserved capacity is treated as CapEx-like operating commitment for runway calc (we amortize the monthly payment).
Leila (FP&A): Action: I'll post an updated 12/18/24 scenario churn later today with a hiring freeze and with hiring-on plan.
Maya (People Ops): If we pause hires, what happens to contractor renewals? Any thresholds where we allow renewals for critical roles?
Ava (Finance): We will grandfather critical contractor renewals up to 3 months if manager gets VP signoff. Noncritical renewals put on hold until next spend review.
Priya (Product): Can you remind us the approval flow for procurement? We had a team trying to expedite a vendor purchase and got stuck.
Ava (Finance): Procurement flow (short):
```
- < $5k: manager approval
- $5k - $50k: manager + finance lead
- $50k - $250k: manager + finance lead + procurement
- > $250k: VP + procurement + CFO approval
```
Also use the vendor portal (https://vendor.redwood.internal) and cc procurement@redwood.com for any > $50k. Expedited requests: include a 1-paragraph business case and a preferred delivery date.
Jonas (Eng): For Dedicated infra buys, is there a separate committee? Hardware spend sometimes gets flagged late.
Ava (Finance): Yes, hardware > $100k goes to the Infra Spend Committee (Eng lead + Infra PM + Finance). They fast-track or push to next cycle depending on capacity.
Sam (CEO): Quick note — the priority is keeping product velocity while protecting runway. If there's a clear ROI inside 6 months, bring it forward and we'll evaluate.
Priya (Product): Thanks Sam. For the Optimize cost-reduction experiments, any liberty to A/B in prod? Would like to run a pilot that switches small % of traffic to quantized models.
Ava (Finance): We can greenlight pilots that reduce unit cost without serious quality regressions. Please file a cost-impact estimate in the #eng-runtime channel and copy me.
Leila (FP&A): I'll add a rolling 3-month lookahead in the weekly report — will include committed vs optional infra, headcount, and vendor milestones.
finance-bot: Posted: 'Slides from today's all-hands — finance deep-dive' https://files.redwood/slides/ah-finance-2026.pdf
Jonas (Eng): One practical question — if a team needs to exceed their monthly spend cap temporarily, what's the fastest path?
Ava (Finance): For temporary overages under $15k: manager + finance lead approval via #spend-approvals. For > $15k: VP + finance + procurement signoff. Include mitigation plan (how you reduce spend next month).
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — hiring freeze exceptions (for mission-critical hires) should include a 1-paragraph justification and fallback plan if not approved. We'll coordinate with finance.
Priya (Product): Anything changing on the customer credits / free tier? That impacts short-term revenue.
Ava (Finance): No change today. We're modeling modest uptake; if usage spikes we'll bring proposals to leadership.
Sam (CEO): Appreciate the clarity. Ava/Leila, can you post an updated FAQ and a one-pager on the approvals process by EOD tomorrow? I'd like managers to have a clear rubric.
Ava (Finance): Will do — I'll post the FAQ in #all-hands-followups and pin it.
Leila (FP&A): I'll also schedule a 30-min office hour Friday for any team leads to walk through scenarios.
Priya (Product): Thanks — super helpful.
Jonas (Eng): Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Ava (Finance): Thanks folks — keep the questions here if anything else comes up.
